title: warm HTTP-function demo evidence (v1)
description: Outcome vocabulary for the warm HTTP-function microVM demo (plan todo 28). The demo serves ONE minimal static Rust HTTP function from a pinned local rootfs, snapshots after service readiness, restores through the orchestrator into a warm pool, and reports cold first-call vs warm pool/request latency. The artifact is NEVER a binary pass/fail gate: a 'pass' field would encode a hidden SLA and obscure the actual distribution. This schema forbids any 'pass' field at every level via additionalProperties:false plus an explicit not-required rule. A blocked demo records blocked_reason with null cold/warm data and zero trials; samples are never fabricated. Reviewers compare the recorded cold_first_call_ms and warm p50/p95/p99 against the reference target (metadata only), not against a boolean.

not.description: Fail-closed rule: a demo artifact MUST NOT carry a top-level 'pass' field. additionalProperties:false already rejects unknown top-level keys; this not-required clause is kept explicit so the prohibition is greppable.

class.description: Constant discriminator. Every demo artifact sets this to 'warm_http_demo'.

host_metadata.description: Snapshot of the host substrate at demo time (reused from the benchmark harness). Required so the latencies are reproducible and reviewable; never lie about nested or cgroup-v2.

workload.description: The single pinned function/rootfs workload. payload_sha256 is the content hash of the pinned local rootfs the function is packaged in.

cold_first_call_ms.description: Cold first-call latency in milliseconds (spawn -> request, including boot to readiness and snapshot). Null when the cold start failed (e.g. guest never ready) or the demo was blocked.

warm_p50_ms.description: Warm request p50 (ms), or null when no warm samples were collected.

warm_p95_ms.description: Warm request p95 (ms), or null when no warm samples were collected.

warm_p99_ms.description: Warm request p99 (ms), or null when no warm samples were collected.

warm.description: Full warm request distribution computed by the microvm-bench harness. Failed warm attempts are recorded in 'failures' and excluded from the percentiles, never zero-filled.

warmup_count.description: Number of VMs successfully pre-restored (warmed) into the pool.

request_trials.description: Number of warm request attempts (successful + failed). Equals the sample budget so every trial is accounted for.

restore_trials.description: Total restore attempts (warmup fills + on-demand restores + no-snapshot attempts).

cold_phases.description: Cumulative phase durations from process initiation (t=0), plus a representative warm restore_ready. Null when the cold start failed. Records spawn/socket/configured/guest-ready/snapshot-ready/restore-ready/request timings.

cleanup.description: Evidence that demo resources were cleaned up after the run. Always present.

blocked_reason.description: Stable token explaining why the demo could not run, or null when it ran. Token vocabulary matches the benchmark harness BlockedReason.

blocked_detail.description: Human-readable blocked evidence, or null when the demo ran.
